canopy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single isolated image-to-3D modelling reference for a game-ready kitesurfing canopy. Reference image 1 is COLOR/GRAPHIC/MATERIAL inspiration only: the vintage flame-painted surf woodie car; do not depict the car, beach, boards, people or signage. Create a high-quality Crash Bandicoot 4-style stylized 3D game prop: one inflated leading-edge kitesurfing kite CANOPY ONLY, no flying lines, no control bar, no person, no floor. Broad continuous crescent/C-shaped arched canopy, symmetrical span, downturned swept wing tips, believable thin tensioned ripstop fabric with three chunky inflatable ribs on its concave underside and a substantial curved inflated leading-edge tube. Span-to-chord about 3.6:1. Center high and both tips visibly lower. Show a clear slightly elevated front three-quarter asset view that reveals the full crescent arch, the fabric graphic, underside ribs and swept depth. Large worn faded charcoal/dark-grey fabric panels with irregular washed-out grey splotches, salt fading and sun-bleached fabric, not solid black. Bold old-school hot-rod flame tongues running from the leading edge back across the cloth, pale golden yellow flame roots blending to warm orange and deep red pointed tips, thin faded ivory pinstripe outline. Broad clean flame shapes readable at game distance, inspired by the attached car paint. Slightly asymmetrical flame graphic over symmetrical wing geometry. Fabric seams, stitched reinforcement at each wing tip and a few reinforced bridle tabs along the leading edge; make the tabs substantial but do not add strings. Gentle worn edges and small mended fabric patches, sturdy usable condition, no large rips or holes. Chunky appealing handcrafted shapes, hand-painted material treatment, restrained stylized facets, soft rich material shading, high silhouette quality. The flame pattern is painted INTO the weathered fabric, not literal fire and not metal bodywork. Full object centered, roomy margin, nothing cropped. Neutral soft studio lighting without dramatic cast shadows. Transparent background. No text, labels, logo or watermark.
bar: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a separate single-object modelling reference for the wooden control bar of a kitesurfing game prop. Input image 1 is the vintage surf woodie car: use its warm timber, muted vintage trim and hand-painted old-school vibe only. Input image 2 is the matching weathered flame kite canopy: match its Crash Bandicoot 4-style chunky stylized game art and worn material quality. Create ONLY a horizontal kitesurf control BAR, no kite, no flying lines, no hands, no ground. One sturdy hand-carved warm brown wooden crossbar, rounded shaft with a very shallow ergonomic sweep, thick end knobs with soft bevels and slightly imperfect worn wood. It is a handled control rod, NOT a bow, not a weapon and not a steering wheel. Width about six times its average thickness, believable hand-held size. Exaggerated carved grain and broad subtle dents; pale worn high spots and dark rubbed grain grooves. Two chunky brown rope-wrapped hand grip zones evenly spaced left/right, leaving a short visible wooden center section. Left end has a faded reddish-orange painted identification band; right end a weathered cream band. A narrow dark brass mounting band at the middle, simple solid band; the separate center guide hardware will be built manually later. Overall shape should be simple, appealing and easily readable, solid and practical. No dangling rope ends, no strings, no separate loose objects. A single high-quality 3D game asset render, horizontal, slight three-quarter angle from above so we can see its rounded volume, entire object centered with margin. Soft neutral studio light, no dramatic shadows, no text or logos. Transparent background.
